notes: Leapmotor Australian Tier 1 BEV research checked 15 October 2026. Four complete current manufacturer model/body cohorts contain nine exact named versions: B05 MY26 Style and Design LR; B10 MY26 BEV Style and Design LR; current C10 Style, Design LR and AWD Sports+ Special Edition; B03X Style and Design LR. A separately evidenced MY25 C10 Design residual-new advertisement is the tenth catalogue identity, outside these current official cohorts.

Current maker cohort reviews do not certify that older residual-new versions, unconfirmed global names or distinct future model leads have been exhausted. Formal MY26 applies only to the printed B05/B10 maker guides; C10 current/AWD and B03X keep null formal model years. BEVs remain distinct from range-extender hybrids.

CarsGuide lists four current model families: B03X, B05, B10 and C10. Its older-model section lists D19. CarExpert lists B03X/B05/B10/C10 plus D19/T03 and warns that global or future names are not necessarily Australian on-sale vehicles. These two brand-level pages do not close separate whole-market C1 reconciliation.

C1 includes three explicitly advertised pre-order versions: B03X Style, B03X Design LR and C10 AWD Sports+. They stay announced/provisional and outside the seven-version on-sale coverage/ranking denominator. The narrow reporter predicate requires an explicit order token, a current valid availability review and usable cited sources. Mere arrival timing does not create C1 eligibility.

November 2026 is the advertised B03X dealership arrival, not a customer-delivery promise. Factory-order acceptance and physical stock remain unverified for all ten versions. MY25 C10 Design is a specific dealer-advertised New Car, not proof of physical possession or the complete residual-new range nationwide.

Published 30–80% charging times remain source-scoped and do not fill strict 10–80% coverage; ten separate two-source searches retain 10–80% Not published facts. Maker B05/AWD MSRP with unknown on-road treatment remains supplemental; selected before-on-road secondary prices remain Reported and unranked. B05 towing preserves the Reported 750 kg braked value and CarsGuide 0 kg/no-towing conflict, with no inferred ATM/GTM basis.
